note: Capability -> page manifest: the claim that every shipped user-facing capability has a page. `source` is an owning-area label, not a filesystem path: it is the `monolith` code path when code owns the behavior (`monolith/app/Domain/**`), and an owning-area label (`silverspoon/platform`, `silverspoon/finance`, `silverspoon/legal`) when the page documents policy, brand, or infrastructure that no single code path owns. `npm run check:docs` fails when a page does not exist or is not reachable from sidebars.ts.

waivers.currency.catalog: Admin-only currency and FX catalog — operators only.
waivers.activity-log.audit-trail: Admin-only audit trail viewer — operators only.
waivers.error-log.grouped-errors: Admin-only persistent error viewer — operators only.
waivers.navigation.menu-tree: Admin-only menu tree editor — operators only.
waivers.settings.platform: Admin-only runtime settings editor — operators only.
